recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, two-color composition featuring a vertical split. The left third contains a grainy, high-contrast portrait of a man in sunglasses, while the right two-thirds consists of a solid color field with structured, left-aligned typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical division between image and negative space
High-contrast threshold effect on the portrait
Monochromatic color palette with dark green ink on a yellow-ochre background
Juxtaposition of bold slab-serif display type with delicate typewriter body text
coreInvariants: Grainy, screen-printed texture across the entire image
Portrait cropped to the left edge

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Portrait occupies the left 35% of the frame, vertically centered and cropped at the shoulders.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, high-contrast sunglasses of the subject serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the dark portrait on the left, moves right to the bold display text, then down to the smaller metadata text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large open area in the upper right and center right provides breathing room for the typography.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, high value contrast between the two colors.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric slab serif and monospaced typewriter
letterConstructionRules: Display text uses heavy, blocky slab serifs with low contrast
Body text uses thin, monospaced strokes with visible 'ink-bleed' texture
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'w' in display text has a wide, sturdy base
Typewriter characters have slight irregularities in alignment
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold, heavy display slab serif paired with a light, airy typewriter face for functional contrast.
graphicDevices: Vertical dividing line (implied by image crop)

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif display style
Provides the necessary typewriter texture for body text
Alternative for the display text with similar geometric slab qualities

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a two-tone image with a yellow-ochre background. On the left third, place a high-contrast dark green threshold-style portrait of a man with sunglasses and a 70s hairstyle. Apply a heavy paper grain and screen-print texture across the entire canvas.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, bold dark green slab-serif title in the middle-right section. Below it, add three lines of small dark green typewriter-style text. Add a single line of small dark green sans-serif text at the very top and bottom right corners.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly two-tone?
Is the portrait high-contrast with no mid-tones?
Is the grain texture visible across the whole image?

mustRedesign: Exact phrasing of the original text
Specific facial features of the original subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no white pixels are present
Check that the slab serif is sufficiently heavy
Verify the typewriter text has a 'stamped' feel
Confirm the vertical split is roughly at the 1/3 mark
recipe.reuseFormula: Duotone High-Contrast Portrait + Slab Serif Display + Typewriter Body + Heavy Grain Texture
